02-delete-workload-grants.description: Removing workload access removes the leak and required ConfigMap grants.

03-valid-repair.description: Remove only the foreign Secret binding; keep required and operator grants.

04-leftover-cluster-grant.description: A remaining ClusterRoleBinding still grants the forbidden access.

05-group-grant.description: The fixed service-account group grants access without naming the workload.

06-legitimate-other-subject-secret.description: Secret access for another identity does not violate the frontend contract.

07-required-name-restriction.description: One permitted ConfigMap name cannot satisfy required access for every name.

08-literal-star-name.description: resourceNames star is a literal, not an object-name wildcard.

09-wildcard-resource.description: A resource wildcard includes core Secrets.

10-wildcard-api-group.description: An API-group wildcard includes the core API group.

12-disjoint-api-group.description: An apps-group resource called secrets does not grant core Secret access.

13-wrong-subject-namespace.description: A service account in another namespace is a different identity.

14-default-subject-namespace.description: An omitted service-account namespace on RoleBinding defaults to binding namespace.

15-local-role-reference.description: Namespaced Role resolution grants within the binding namespace.

16-operator-regression.description: Frontend contract passes, but deleting an unrelated operator grant violates preservation.

17-missing-reference.description: Incomplete input is not accepted as a no-grant proof.

18-aggregation-boundary.description: An empty aggregate selects no roles; its stored and selected permissions agree.

19-unknown-field.description: Unknown fields must not produce a proof.

20-duplicate-object.description: Duplicate object identities make the snapshot ambiguous.

21-named-secret-leak.description: A narrow but forbidden Secret grant must yield that exact name as witness.

22-disjoint-verb.description: This named-get contract says nothing about list access; it is explicitly outside scope.

23-nul-verb-literal.description: A NUL-containing verb is not the literal get; decoding must preserve that distinction.

24-nul-api-group-literal.description: A NUL-containing API group is not the empty core API group.

25-nul-resource-literal.description: A NUL-containing resource is not configmaps.

26-trailing-json-document.description: The complete original input must be consumed; trailing documents are outside this JSON-only experiment.

27-trailing-yaml-document.description: The complete original input must be consumed; trailing documents are outside this JSON-only experiment.

28-unsafe-local-role-control.description: Equivalent forbidden grant through a local Role, controlling for KubeLinter binding-shape coverage.

29-legitimate-ops-local-secret.description: Another identity legitimately reads Secrets through a local Role; the fixed frontend contract still holds.

30-stale-aggregation.description: An empty aggregate selects a Secret-reading leaf; stale stored rules must not yield a safety proof.
